label: late input m in sequences starting with p (too sparse)
explanation: Only 33 of 1M sequences active (15 steps on dev). Fires only during the original-input phase, at positions 4-7, almost always (14/15 dev) in sequences whose first token is p. The input token is usually m (77% of mass), sometimes d/h/j, and an h usually appears earlier in the sequence. Never fires on the delimiter or in the copy phase. The predicate is far too broad (precision about 4%), so this is a rare conjunction-detector and there are too few examples to characterize it reliably. I did not check what drives magnitude beyond the top examples, which are m inputs after p...h prefixes.
